reconcile.intro: This page compares your saved card with what the data underneath it says today. It is a read-only review: nothing here edits, rebuilds, upgrades, or re-saves the card, and the saved snapshot is untouched.
reconcile.sourceHelp: Every comparison below is against this exact saved state, named by its revision so it stays identifiable after the card is edited again.
reconcile.operationalHelp: The authored release, the pinned catalogue release, and every reviewed definition are held exactly as this card recorded them. Only what the room stocks, how the site ranks it, and what the location can do are read as they are today — so everything below is caused by those and by nothing else.
reconcile.operationalIdentical: Nothing has changed. Re-resolving this card against today's hospital-local data produces the card you saved.
reconcile.operationalHeldBroken: Something outside hospital-local data differs, which should not be possible while the release is held fixed: {keys}
reconcile.releaseHelp: How the release this card is pinned to compares with the release this procedure currently points at. The comparison is between the two definition sets; the card itself is never resolved against the newer one.
reconcile.releaseOnCurrent: This card is pinned to the release this procedure currently points at. There is nothing to compare.
reconcile.releaseNoCurrent: This procedure does not currently point at any published release, so there is nothing to compare this card's pinned release with.
reconcile.releaseIdentical: The two releases pin the same definitions. Nothing a card resolves from differs between them.
reconcile.releaseCatalogChanged: The two releases were published against different catalogue releases.
reconcile.releaseContractChanged: The two releases were published under different resolver contract versions.
reconcile.requirementChangesHelp: Matched on the reviewed requirement identity each line carries, and on nothing else — never on role code alone and never on resembling labels.
reconcile.hasSelection: You selected a product for it
reconcile.noRebuildNotice: Reviewing changes does not rebuild this card, and this page cannot: it reads and reports, and the card stays exactly as you saved it. Moving a card onto a newer release is a separate, reviewed workflow that creates a new card from one exact saved revision and leaves this one untouched — start it from the card’s own page.

revisions.heading: Saved states
revisions.help: Every state this card has been saved in, newest first. Revisions are append-only: they are written when the card is saved and are never rewritten.
revisions.empty: No saved states have been recorded for this card yet.
revisions.sameContent: Same content as the revision before it

rebuild.intro: This reviews one exact saved state of this card against the release this procedure points at today, and creates a NEW draft card from it. The card you are looking at is not changed, not upgraded, and not re-saved — it keeps its own release, its own snapshot, its own share link, and its own history.
rebuild.sourceHeading: What is being rebuilt, and onto what
rebuild.sourceHelp: The rebuild is bound to one immutable revision rather than to the card, so it stays identifiable after the card is edited again. The target is the release this procedure’s explicit pointer names — never the newest one by version or date.
rebuild.targetRelease: Release it would be built on
rebuild.sourceUnchangedNotice: Creating the new card writes one row. Nothing on this page can change the original card, its revisions, its snapshot, or its share link.
rebuild.decisionsHelp: Every requirement whose definition moved, every selection that could not be carried, and every requirement this release adds or removes has to be answered individually. There is no control that accepts them all at once.
rebuild.blockingHelp: The new card cannot ask for these. A required requirement whose selection could not be carried comes across empty, and the draft opens in the builder so a product can be chosen there.
rebuild.reviewHelp: The selection still exists and is still allowed, but something about the requirement, the product line, or the free text moved. It is offered as a suggestion and is not applied until you confirm it.
rebuild.addedHelp: Requirements this release expresses and the source revision never carried. They begin unresolved: no product is chosen for them, because nothing in the released definitions authors one.
rebuild.removedHelp: Requirements the newer release no longer expresses, and selections that no longer resolve against the target release’s catalogue or the equipment the room stocks.
rebuild.waiverHelp: A waiver is never carried. It records that a named person accepted a named risk under a named set of definitions, and under a different release those are not the same definitions. The earlier rationale is shown for reference only.
rebuild.carriedHelp: The requirement key, the released definition, and the exact identity of what was chosen are all unchanged, so these need no decision. They are listed so the review is a complete account rather than only the parts that moved.
rebuild.carriedCount: {requirements, plural, =0 {Nothing carried unchanged.} one {# requirement carried unchanged.} other {# requirements carried unchanged.}}
rebuild.createNotice: This creates a new draft card with its own id, its own share link switched off, and a record of the revision it was built from and the decisions you made. It is a draft: open it in the builder to finish anything left unresolved.
rebuild.unavailableTitle: This card cannot be rebuilt automatically
rebuild.unavailableSourceIntact: The card itself is unaffected. Its saved snapshot still views, prints, and shares exactly as it did.
rebuild.unavailableRevisionUnverifiable: This revision’s stored snapshot no longer matches the hash it was written with, so it cannot be shown or rebuilt from. Choose another revision from the card’s history.
rebuild.unavailableLegacy: This revision was written before the builder recorded selections in a form that can be mapped forward, so there is nothing to carry.
rebuild.unavailableSuperseded: This revision predates release pinning, so the definitions it resolved through were never recorded. Rebuilding it would mean choosing which rules it was built against, which is a decision no automatic mapping is entitled to make.
rebuild.unavailableLegacyFamily: This revision names a product line by a catalogue-browsing key rather than a reviewed family. Deciding which products that key stands for today would be a guess about what the physician is asking the room for.
rebuild.unavailableSourceRelease: The release this revision pins is no longer retrievable intact, so what it was built from cannot be reconstructed to compare against.
rebuild.unavailableNoCurrentRelease: Nothing currently points at a release for this procedure, so there is no target to rebuild onto. The release a card moves to is always read from the explicit pointer, never inferred from version numbers or dates.
rebuild.unavailableAlreadyCurrent: This revision is already pinned to the release this procedure points at, so a rebuild would produce a copy rather than move anything. Editing the card re-resolves it against today’s equipment.
rebuild.unavailableTargetNotSelectable: The release this procedure points at is a draft or has been retired, and neither can back a new card.
rebuild.unavailableTargetRelease: The release this procedure points at cannot be reconstructed intact, so nothing can be mapped onto it.
rebuild.unavailableTargetCatalog: The catalogue release the target release pins is no longer retained, so product identity on the new card could not be reconstructed.
rebuild.unavailableComposition: The requested composition includes a module or modifier the target release does not offer.

error.review_incomplete: Every changed or unresolved decision has to be answered before a new card can be created. The ones still needing an answer are highlighted below.
error.plan_moved: The definitions underneath this rebuild changed while the page was open, so the decisions recorded on it describe choices this rebuild would no longer make. The plan below is the current one; please read it again.
error.not_resolvable: The reviewed selections do not resolve into a card against the target release. Nothing was created.
error.write_failed: The new card could not be saved. Nothing was created.
error.plan_blocked: This rebuild cannot be planned: the target release expresses a requirement in more than one way, so there is no single requirement to carry a selection onto. Nothing was created, and the release itself has to be corrected first.
error.source_moved: The card this rebuild was taken from has changed or been deleted since the review, so nothing was created.
error.review_unavailable: No se pudo calcular una de las comparaciones que componen esta revisión, así que no hay nada que revisar y no se creó nada.

rebuild.provenanceHelp: Esta tarjeta se construyó a partir de un estado guardado exacto de otra tarjeta, con una versión más reciente, después de revisar cada decisión modificada. Lo registrado abajo se escribió una sola vez, al crear la tarjeta, y no puede cambiarse.

rebuild.provenanceSourceLink: Abrir el historial de la tarjeta de origen
rebuild.provenanceSourceGone: La tarjeta de la que se construyó esta ha sido eliminada, y sus revisiones desaparecieron con ella. Los identificadores y las huellas de abajo siguen diciendo exactamente qué se revisó y pueden comprobarse contra una copia de esa revisión si existe, pero la revisión ya no está disponible y no puede recuperarse a partir de este registro.
rebuild.provenanceDecisionsHelp: {answered} de {total} decisiones necesitaron respuesta; el resto se trasladó sin cambios.
rebuild.provenanceUnreadableHeading: No se puede leer el registro de reconstrucción de esta tarjeta
rebuild.provenanceUnreadableBody: La base de datos indica que esta tarjeta se creó mediante una reconstrucción revisada, pero el registro que contiene no tiene una forma que esta versión de la aplicación pueda interpretar. La tarjeta en sí no ha cambiado y sigue siendo plenamente utilizable; lo que no se puede mostrar es cómo llegó a existir. Comuníquelo: el registro es de escritura única, así que está intacto y podrá leerse cuando se aclare la discrepancia.

status.notResearched: This product was not covered by the U.S. status research snapshot, so its current availability and its FDA safety-action status have not been verified.
status.orderabilityNote: Market status describes distribution evidence recorded at the research snapshot. It does not establish present orderability, local availability, formulary status, procurement, or clinical suitability.

safetyDetail.safety_identity_review_required: An FDA safety action was matched only at product-family or ambiguous identity level, not to this exact product. The match needs identity review before it is interpreted, so no action number is shown here.

devices.metadataDescription: Read-only atlas of verified interventional pulmonology devices with source citations.
devices.title: Device Atlas
devices.intro: A read-only reference of interventional pulmonology devices. Every catalog product whose specifications trace to a verified source appears here, whether or not its current U.S. availability has been established. Current market status and FDA safety actions are shown as labels on the product, never as reasons to omit it. Every fact carries its citation.
devices.cohortRule: Cohort rule: verification_grade = verified_source, minus explicit reviewed owner exclusions. Current availability is not a condition of inclusion.
devices.exclusionNote: Candidate-grade and unknown-grade catalog products are not shown here. They remain reviewable on the existing public-unlisted (direct-link) catalog surfaces.
devices.unknownFilter: The "{filter}" filter value is not recognized.
devices.legacyCategoryNotice: Los filtros de categoría y subcategoría fueron reemplazados por el filtro normalizado de clase de dispositivo. El valor de clasificación de este enlace no se aplicó.

devices.noResults: No products in the atlas cohort match these filters.
devices.statusNote: Market-status and safety labels come from a dated U.S. status research snapshot, named on each product page. They describe the evidence at that date; they do not establish present orderability, and an absence of findings is not a clean bill of health.

device.metadataDescription: Verified device facts with source citations.
device.specsMissingNote: A value shown as "not recorded" means the source documents reviewed so far do not state it — not that the device lacks it.

taxonomy.discoveryNote: La clase y el subtipo de dispositivo son agrupaciones normalizadas de descubrimiento de catálogo según el tipo físico del dispositivo. No constituyen nunca afirmaciones de equivalencia clínica, sustitución, compatibilidad, formulario institucional ni disponibilidad de pedido.

device.provenanceNote: Campos de categoría del catálogo original, mostrados solo como procedencia. La navegación del atlas usa la clase y el subtipo de dispositivo normalizados de arriba.
device.rolesDiscoveryNote: Role membership is a catalog-discovery fact recorded in the governed product–role table. It is not a clinical equivalence or substitution claim.
device.noRoles: No clinical-role mappings are recorded for this product.
device.proceduresNote: Slots where this product is an authored option in a procedure template. All procedures shown are governance drafts; each carries its verbatim status.
device.ruleConditionNote: Displayed as an authored condition. Nothing is evaluated on this page — evaluation happens only inside the preference-card resolver.
device.noCompatibilityData: No compatibility statements are recorded for this product.
device.noSources: No source citations are recorded for this product.
device.displayOnlyGroupingNote: Display-only grouping by manufacturer and product line for discovery. It is never persisted as identity and is not a clinical equivalence group.
device.otherManufacturersHeading: Other manufacturers with products mapped to this clinical role
device.roleDiscoveryCaption: Shared clinical-role mapping is a catalog-discovery fact, not a claim that these products are clinically equivalent or substitutable.
device.otherManufacturersSelectionNote: One product per manufacturer, drawn from {productCount, plural, one {# cohort product} other {# cohort products}} across {manufacturerCount, plural, one {# other manufacturer} other {# other manufacturers}} mapped to this role ({shown} shown). Representatives prefer primary-fit mappings and are otherwise arbitrary — never a matched or comparable set, and sizes are not matched.
device.otherManufacturersViewRole: View every cohort product mapped to this role.

role.metadataDescription: One clinical role across manufacturers, with authored selection guidance quoted verbatim.
role.membershipNote: Products listed under this role share a catalog-discovery mapping. Role membership is a discovery fact — it is not clinical equivalence, interchangeability, or a substitution recommendation.
role.guidanceVerbatim: Quoted verbatim from the governed role table; never paraphrased.
role.guidanceGenericNote: Authored selection guidance is generic educational content from the governed role table. Wording that mentions a formulary or hospital stocking is template language only — it does not establish that any hospital carries, stocks, prefers, approves, or uses any product.
role.productsHeading: Atlas products mapped to this role ({count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}})
role.cohortNote: Only the Device Atlas cohort is listed here (verified source, minus explicit reviewed owner exclusions). Candidate-grade and unknown-grade mapped products may exist on the existing public-unlisted (direct-link) catalog surfaces. Counts reflect catalog-ingestion coverage, not market availability.
role.noCohortProducts: No products in the D1 atlas cohort are mapped to this role.
role.proceduresHeading: Procedures and slots using this role
role.proceduresNote: Every procedure template slot that requests this role, with its authored-option status. All procedures are governance drafts.
role.noProcedures: No procedure slots request this role.
role.proposalCount: {count, plural, one {# unreviewed proposal} other {# unreviewed proposals}}
role.evidenceHeading: How to read the evidence states

evidence.verifiedSource: Product specifications trace to a verified primary source (for example GUDID/UDI or a manufacturer IFU), cited on the device page.
evidence.authoredSelectable: A clinician-authored, reviewed slot option that the preference-card builder may select.
evidence.authoredNonSelectable: An authored slot option that reviewers deliberately hold out of selection; shown for context only.
evidence.unreviewedProposal: A machine-derived suggestion awaiting review. Never selectable, never public beyond counts, and never satisfies coverage or readiness.

role.currentIfuFooter: This role is flagged in the governed role table as requiring current instructions-for-use review — as nearly every role in this atlas is. Confirm compatibility and sizing against the current IFU before clinical use.
role.availabilityNone: No procedure in this release has an authored selectable option for this role.
role.availabilitySome: Authored selectable options for this role exist in {count, plural, one {# procedure} other {# procedures}} in this release.
role.singleManufacturerNote: All cohort products for this role are from one manufacturer: {manufacturer}.

readiness.metadataDescription: Deterministic demo-data-only readiness projection for a Phase D1 exemplar procedure.
readiness.title: Demo readiness — {procedure}
readiness.demoTitle: DEMO DATA — NOT AN ACTUAL INSTITUTION
readiness.demoDisclaimer: Every state below is computed from the fictional "Demo IP Program" context to prove the deterministic rules against real catalog structure. It reports on no real room, no real inventory, and no real institution, and makes no procurement recommendation.
readiness.realFormularyHeadline: Not ready — no institutional data recorded.
readiness.realFormularyBody: {rows} formulary staging rows intersect the roles of this procedure; {carried} are marked as carried and {preferred} as preferred. The scaffold holds no institutional signal.
readiness.realFormularyNote: This empty scaffold is not institutional data and is never presented as such. The projection below runs on the explicitly fictional demo context instead.
readiness.demoProjectionNote: Evaluated for {organization} · {location} with the scenario default modifiers ({modifiers}), through the existing resolver — this page adds a pure projection over its output and persists nothing.

evidence.noMapping: No institutional mapping in the demo context.

readiness.noRescueDefinedFact: No rescue module is defined for this procedure. This is reported as a fact of the release-pinned composition, not as a missing-rescue-pathway state.

legend.ready: The demo mapping is an authored selectable option on a verified-source product and no limitation applies (spec §4 rule 1). Any resolver advisory about the mapping — for example a pending current-local-verification check — is quoted verbatim beneath the state chip.
legend.ready_with_limitations: Coverage exists but at least one limitation applies — a demo stand-in, candidate-grade evidence, an unresolved conditional requirement, or a compatibility check that evaluated unknown.
legend.not_ready: At least one required requirement has no institutional mapping at all.
legend.missing_required_product_role: A required requirement whose role has no authored selectable option anywhere in the catalog (proposals-only or wholly unmapped) — a structural gap independent of any institution.
legend.missing_room_capability: A room capability named by the composition or a selected modifier is absent from the location context — the same check that produces the resolver’s blocking message.
legend.missing_rescue_pathway: A reachable rescue module has a requirement with no coverage, or the module itself fails to resolve.
legend.available_but_unverified: Coverage exists only through unverified evidence: a demo-only or unverified mapping, a candidate/unknown-grade product, or a compatibility rule that could not be evaluated. Never a silent pass.
legend.inventory_formulary_mismatch: An institutional assertion disagrees with authored eligibility — for example a carried product that is not an authored selectable option. It cannot fire from a scaffold that carries no assertions.

readiness.legendSafetyNote: Safety rules: candidate or unknown evidence never produces plain Ready; demo stand-ins always force a limitation; unreviewed proposals never count as coverage; a missing attribute resolves to unknown rather than passing.
readiness.noProcurementNote: This is a demo/readiness gap preview over fictional data. It is not a procurement report, a shortage analysis, or a substitution recommendation for any hospital.
readiness.otherWarnings: {count, plural, one {# other resolver message, quoted verbatim} other {# other resolver messages, quoted verbatim}}
readiness.realFormularyHeadlineNonEmpty: Formulary staging rows carry institutional assertions. Phase D1 shows them as data only; institutional readiness remains unevaluated.
readiness.realFormularyLocalFields: {count, plural, one {# row carries} other {# rows carry}} a populated local field, shown for honesty about what the scaffold holds.

outputs.heading: Read-only output previews
outputs.readOnlyNote: All previews are recomputed projections of one resolved demo card. Nothing is saved, exported, or written in Phase D1.

card.heading: Preference card — existing builder
card.body: Preference cards remain the existing engine, unchanged. This workspace links into the builder for the matching scenario; it does not duplicate it.
card.builderNote: The builder opens in the preserved preference-cards area with its own access rules; saving a card requires an account.

nursing.allUnassignedNote: No resolved requirement of this procedure carries a responsible role, so this preview cannot group by role yet. Until responsible roles are authored, its line set is identical to the Training preview; the list below is shown flat, without a role grouping.

training.authoredOnlyNote: Every clinical sentence below is authored text quoted from the governed catalog (generic requirement, selection guidance, dependency rule). Nothing is machine-generated.
training.currentIfuAdvisory: Role flagged as requiring current instructions-for-use review before clinical use.
training.currentIfuUniversalNote: Every role in this preview is flagged as requiring current instructions-for-use review before clinical use — stated once here instead of repeated on every line.

gaps.demoOnlyNote: Demo/readiness gap preview — structural gaps in the governed catalog plus the demo projection. Because no real institution exists in this system, this is NOT a procurement report for any hospital.
gaps.proposalsOnlyRoles: Roles covered only by unreviewed proposals
gaps.proposalsNote: Proposal counts are shown for review load only; proposals never satisfy coverage.

gaps.nonSelectableRoles: Roles with authored but non-selectable options only
gaps.dimensionGapCount: {count, plural, one {# authored-option product has} other {# authored-option products have}} all eight dimension fields empty.
gaps.formularyBody: No institutional inventory is recorded: {rows} staging rows intersect this procedure, {carried} carried, {preferred} preferred.

outputs.demoDisclaimer: These previews resolve the fictional "Demo IP Program" context. They describe no real room, no real inventory, and no real institution, and they make no procurement recommendation.
